Package pl.rentathing.item.controller

Class AdminInventoryController

java.lang.Object
pl.rentathing.item.controller.AdminInventoryController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/admin/inventory") public class AdminInventoryController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling administrative operations related to the inventory. Allows management of categories, items, and provides functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and listing inventory items and categories in the admin panel.

  • Method Details

    • inventoryPage

      @GetMapping public String inventoryPage(ItemSearchCriteria itemCriteria, @RequestParam(defaultValue="0") int page, @RequestParam(name="category",required=false) String searchCat, @RequestParam(name="sortCat",required=false,defaultValue="idDesc") String sortCat, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Displays the inventory page for the admin panel. Allows filtering, sorting, and pagination of items, as well as interaction with categories and item data.
      Parameters:
      itemCriteria - the criteria used to filter items in the inventory
      page - the current page number for pagination, defaults to 0
      searchCat - the optional category name or criteria for filtering the displayed categories
      sortCat - the sorting parameter for categories, defaults to "idDesc"
      model - the Spring Model object used to pass data to the view
      Returns:
      the name of the template to render the admin inventory page

    • addCategory

      @PostMapping("/category/add") public String addCategory(@RequestParam String name, @RequestParam(required=false) String description, @RequestParam(required=false) String iconClass)
      Adds a new category to the system and redirects to the inventory management page.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the category to be added
      description - an optional description for the category
      iconClass - an optional icon class for the category
      Returns:
      a redirect string to navigate back to the categories section of the inventory page

    • showEditForm

      @GetMapping("/edit/{id}") public String showEditForm(@PathVariable Long id, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Handles the request to display the edit form for an item. Retrieves the item details and category list to populate the edit form.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the item to be edited
      model - the Model object used to pass data to the view
      Returns:
      the name of the view to render, typically the edit form view; redirects to the inventory page if the item is not found

    • saveItem

      @PostMapping("/save") public String saveItem(@Valid @ModelAttribute("item") @Valid ItemFormDTO itemDto, org.springframework.validation.BindingResult result, org.springframework.ui.Model model, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes ra)
      Saves the provided item to the inventory. Validates the input data and handles errors accordingly. If the item is new, it is created; otherwise, the existing item is updated.
      Parameters:
      itemDto - the data transfer object containing the details of the item to be saved, which must be validated
      result - the object that holds the result of binding form fields and validation
      model - the model to hold attributes needed for rendering the item form on error
      ra - the redirect attributes to pass messages across redirect scenarios
      Returns:
      a redirect string to the inventory page if successful, or the item creation form if validation or save errors occur
